products.title: Head Coello Junior 2026 - Head
products.description:
HEAD COELLO JUNIOR 2026 - The junior model of the Head range of rackets by "King" Arturo Coello. It is designed to accompany the youngest in their first steps in paddle tennis. INTRODUCTION OF THE SHOVEL

The HEAD COELLO JUNIOR 2026 offers lightness, comfort and ease of handling. With its aesthetic design inspired by Arturo Coello's rackets, it is a perfect option to get started with guarantees in the world of paddle tennis.

PLAYER TYPE

It is especially designed for children who are starting to play paddle tennis, since it is a light, comfortable and easy-to-handle racket.

CHARACTERISTICS OF THE PADDLE

HEAD COELLO JUNIOR 2026 has a teardrop shape and a wide sweet spot. With an approximate weight of 310 grams, this racket is very manageable, allowing the player to move with greater agility on the court. 

The faces are made of fiberglass, which offers a soft and pleasant touch. Its Confort Foam rubber core provides good reactivity, which translates into good ball output. 

In short, the HEAD COELLO JUNIOR 2026 is an ideal racket for the little ones to enjoy padel while developing their game with a racket adapted to their needs.

products.title: Siux Astra Hybrid 2026 - Siux

products.title: Nox Start Black Ex Js 2026 - Nox
products.description:
NOX START BLACK EX JS 2026 - La pala de pádel Nox más recomendada para progresar. Un modelo de genial relación calidad-precio de diseño moderno de temporada 2026/2027. INTRODUCCIÓN DE LA PALA

La NOX START BLACK EX JS 2026 se incorpora a la nueva colección de palas Nox para la temporada 2026. Modelo de formato redondo, un nuevo formato muy peculiar que aporta un control elevado y un punto dulce muy amplio.

TIPO DE JUGADOR

Nos parece una pala especialmente interesante para jugadores que están empezando a jugar con frecuencia y quieren dar un paso adelante respecto a las palas más básicas.

CARACTERÍSTICAS DE LA PALA

El formato redondo elegido para ella, como hemos comentado, favorece un punto dulce amplio y hace que nos perdone bastante bien cuando no golpeamos exactamente por el centro.

Materiales de calidad, como una goma eva HR3 Soft en su núcleo, una de las gomas más cómodas de Nox, pensadas para el control total y una genial reducción de vibraciones.

Los planos están fabricados con fibra de vidrio FG 3K, un material más elástico que el carbono que consigue un golpeo agradable.

products.englishDescription:
NOX START BLACK EX JS 2026 - The most recommended Nox padel racket to progress. A great value for money model with a modern design for the 2026/2027 season. INTRODUCTION OF THE SHOVEL

The NOX START BLACK EX JS 2026 joins the new collection of Nox rackets for the 2026 season. Round format model, a very peculiar new format that provides high control and a very wide sweet spot.

PLAYER TYPE

We find it to be a particularly interesting racket for players who are starting to play frequently and want to take a step forward compared to the most basic rackets.

CHARACTERISTICS OF THE PADDLE

The round format chosen for it, as we have mentioned, favors a wide sweet spot and makes it forgive us quite well when we do not hit exactly in the center.

Quality materials, such as an HR3 Soft eva rubber in its core, one of Nox's most comfortable rubbers, designed for total control and great vibration reduction.

The planes are made of FG 3K fiberglass, a more elastic material than carbon that provides a pleasant hit.
